quests.name: Armour of the Sky: Helm
quests.offer:
You stand in front, so you want a helm that will hold. Bring me a Talisman of the Rhino, a totem of dreams and a phosphoric globe, and I will make it.
Will you bring them?
quests.declined: Talk to me again and I will name another.
quests.started: They drop all over the Plane of Sky, off almost anything.

steps.journal: Bring Stark Goldencrest a Talisman of the Rhino, a totem of dreams and a phosphoric globe for a helm.
steps.reminder: I need all of it: a Talisman of the Rhino, a totem of dreams and a phosphoric globe.
steps.says: There. Let it take the blows meant for you.

quests.notes: EQoA forum t290 (recipes, sets) and EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-sky.json (the givers, level, where the parts drop). A quest a piece so the journal holds its recipe, repeatable for a replacement; the giver offers whichever piece the player holds the parts of (handlers/quests.go readyHandInLocked). No experience: the guide gives none.
